I compared round trips from each safe location by hand. The plan uses only car1, and its total cost is 402 (362 minutes of driving plus 40 in penalties).

**Key findings**
- **Safe locations:** Only Panchakanya shelter and Tadi hospital count as evacuation points. Dhunche temple isn't designated, so its 5 people must be moved too.
- **Car2 stays parked:** Tadi hospital connects only through the 42-minute road to Panchakanya. Any trip by car2 would therefore cost 42 minutes more than the same trip by car1.
- **Unused roads:** Likhu school and Jwalamukhi care home have nobody waiting, and no route through them saves time.

**Trips by car1 (all start and end at Panchakanya)**

| Trip | Route | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Syaphru – Myagang – Trishuli and back | 4 elderly | 104 |
| 2 | Syaphru – Myagang – Trishuli and back | 3 elderly, 1 adult (Myagang) | 104 |
| 3 | Syaphru – Gajuri and back | 2 children, 1 adult (Gajuri), 1 adult (Syaphru) | 86 |
| 4 | Dhunche – Thakre and back | 3 adults (Thakre), 1 child (Dhunche) | 44 |
| 5 | Dhunche and back | 4 adults | 24 |

**Deferral:** 2 adults at Syaphru farm are deferred, for a penalty of 40. Rescuing them would take another 68-minute round trip, so deferring saves 28.
